name: Developer Task Review Evaluation Rubric
metricFormula: matched expected signals / total expected signals * 100

categories.name: Requirement Coverage
categories.description: Measures how many predefined expected requirement signals are present in the evaluated output.

categories.name: Workflow Validation
categories.description: Confirms that the expected five-agent workflow executes successfully and produces requirements, findings, final synthesis, and traces.

interpretation.positive: The agent workflow provides broader requirement-signal coverage than the baseline.
interpretation.equal: The agent workflow and baseline provide equal requirement-signal coverage.
interpretation.negative: The agent workflow has lower requirement-signal coverage than the baseline for the case.

limitations: The metric is based on predefined textual requirement signals.
The metric does not measure complete software quality.
The metric does not prove production readiness.
A keyword-signal regression does not necessarily mean the engineering review is objectively worse.
Automated results should be interpreted together with agent trajectories, repository evidence, verification findings, and human review.
